name: Triple Threat Reads
summary: Warm up your handle, read a live hand signal, attack from triple threat with the jab, then finish with a tough defensive slide circuit.

drills.name: Fingertip Control Circuit
drills.summary: Wake up your hands with tight, quick dribbles at different heights.
steps: Dribble at ankle height with your right hand for 20 seconds, as fast as you can.
Switch to knee height, then waist height, 20 seconds each.
Repeat all three heights with your left hand.
Finish with 30 seconds of crossovers, going lower every 10 seconds.

drills.name: Hand Signal Reads
drills.summary: Read your partner's hand and make the right play fast.
steps: Start at the top of the key with the ball. Your partner stands under the rim facing you.
Drive toward the elbow. Your partner flashes a signal halfway there.
One hand high means pull up and shoot. Hands low means drive to the rim.
Two hands out means jump stop and pass to them.
Go 8 reps, then switch roles and repeat.

drills.name: Jab Step Triple Threat
drills.summary: Use a hard jab to set up the shot or the drive from a catch.
steps: Start on the right wing in triple threat, ball at your hip.
Jab hard with your right foot and watch the imaginary defender.
If they back off, bring the foot back and shoot.
If they close, rip through and take one hard dribble to a pull-up.
Do 3 minutes on the right wing, then 1 minute on the left wing.

drills.name: Square Slide Circuit
drills.summary: Slide, backpedal, sprint and close out around a box to build defensive legs.
steps: Set 4 cones in a square about 5 big steps apart.
Defensive slide across the top from cone 1 to cone 2.
Backpedal down to cone 3, then slide across to cone 4.
Sprint diagonally to cone 2 and finish with a choppy closeout, hands high.
Go 40 seconds on, 20 seconds rest. Switch directions each round.
